planning_notes: The request for 5 targets was fulfilled by selecting 5 distinct concepts from the available pool and assigning each a unique pedagogical facet to ensure non-redundancy. The selection covers the full lifecycle of the neural network: architecture definition (Class-based), data flow (Forward Propagation), error quantification (Loss Function), optimization (Optimizer), and layer mechanics (Layer Connectivity). Facets were chosen to test different cognitive skills: understanding structure, tracing execution, theoretical justification, algorithmic mechanism, and dimensional logic.
